'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Seth Binfield DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Seth Binfield]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' TIEs
* '''Username:''' Sbinfield
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
